body:
> I debugged this a bit more a few weeks ago but I can't find the chat logs about it. IIRC the problem was not `dev_build=yes` per se, but `optimize=none` which it enables. So mbedtls without optimization would end up being broken.

I confirmed this, `scons optimize=none` is enough to reproduce the issue.

> Toggling the `network/tls/enable_tls_v1.3` editor setting doesn't seem to change the behavior, but I have a suspicion that this setting might be broken as the `.3` might be interpreted as a feature override (at least it's styled as such in the editor settings).

I tested some more:

- The setting does seem to work despite the dot in the name. I tried renaming it to `enable_tls_v1_3` and saw similar behavior. I'd suggest we should do this rename anyway to be on the safe side.
- Disabling TLS v1.3 does prevent the issue *in the editor* for the Asset Library. It doesn't solve the issue for the Project Manager, which seems to imply that the Project Manager doesn't respect editor settings.

Depending on which `$CFLAGS` Arch Linux uses, #107754 may still be the same issue as this bug in the end, as they pass custom flags here:
https://gitlab.archlinux.org/archlinux/packaging/packages/godot/-/blob/main/PKGBUILD?ref_type=heads#L60-62

Which should override the one we set with `optimize`. I doubt they pass `-O0` though, usually distros use `-O2` or `-O3`.

*Edit:* I checked which flags Arch Linux uses in its `/etc/makepkg.conf`:
```
CFLAGS="-march=x86-64 -mtune=generic -O2 -pipe -fno-plt -fexceptions \
CXXFLAGS="$CFLAGS -Wp,-D_GLIBCXX_ASSERTIONS"
```

This is pretty standard and similar to our default for `optimize=speed_trace` (`-O2`).

*Edit 2:* Actually `cflags`/`cxxflags` don't override `optimize`, they're added before, not after. One needs to use `optimize=custom` to do let `cflags`/`cxxflags` take precedence.

> I confirmed this, `scons optimize=none` is enough to reproduce the issue.

I confirmed further that `-O0` shows the bug (`optimize=none`) and `-O1` doesn't (`optimize=custom cflags="-O1" cxxflags="-O1"`).

> Depending on which `$CFLAGS` Arch Linux uses, [#107754](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/107754) may still be the same issue as this bug in the end, as they pass custom flags here: https://gitlab.archlinux.org/archlinux/packaging/packages/godot/-/blob/main/PKGBUILD?ref_type=heads#L60-62
> 
> Which should override the one we set with `optimize`. I doubt they pass `-O0` though, usually distros use `-O2` or `-O3`.

Archlinux uses -O2 by default I think. While building the package on my system `$CFLAGS` is set to `-march=x86-64 -mtune=generic -O2 -pipe -fno-plt -fexceptions  -Wp,-D_FORTIFY_SOURCE=3 -Wformat -Werror=format-security -fstack-clash-protection -fcf-protection -fno-omit-frame-pointer -mno-omit-leaf-frame-pointer -g -ffile-prefix-map=<path_to_package>/src=/usr/src/debug/godot -flto=auto -fPIC -Wl,-z,relro,-z,now -w`. So definitely not compiling with optimizations off, but it still could be related.
